analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported its financial performance for the first half of FY 2026-27, highlighting substantial growth in revenue and profitability. During H1 FY27, Revenue from Operations increased by 183.10% to reach ₹19,596.41 lakhs, and Profit After Tax grew by 203.92% to ₹675.73 lakhs compared to H1 FY26. Management emphasized ongoing commitments to strengthen the product portfolio, enhance operational capabilities, maintain financial discipline, and pursue long-term business growth. The company operates from its manufacturing facility in Morbi, Gujarat, with an installed capacity of approximately 72 lakhs p.a. for clocks and 240 lakhs p.a.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a full-year growth of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects next quarter's revenue to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Management described the first quarter as an increasing start reflecting strong operational performance and deadly demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that export is going down due to the increase in price.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has a good order book alongside many pending export orders.
demand_outlook.quote: Now, we have a lot of orders for export, but some orders are pending because, goods are ready, but shipment is not happening.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 6.07% in H1 FY27 compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that margin is fluctuating a bit because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

margins_costs.claim: Margin expansion has been impacted by market competition and increases in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, sir, because market’s competition and revenue has increased, but margin has not increased because of so many problems in raw material price increase and this situation of war in geographies.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the current capacity utilization is 60% to 70% on a quarter-to-quarter basis.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividend paid including corporate dividend tax was ₹120.10 lakhs for the period ended 30-09-2026.
Management confirmed there are no requirements for additional borrowing for now regarding future growth.
Debtors decreased from Rs. 10 crore in 2024-25 to Rs. 6.73 crores in 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: 2024-25 debtors is Rs. 10 crore and 2025-26, debtors is only Rs. 6.73 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted a little bit of impact on exports due to an increase in price.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export demand has been temporarily impacted by logistic problems due to the war scenario.
risks_headwinds.quote: Export demand has been affected. Our main export market is Iraq. We have a lot of orders from Iraq. Goods are also ready. But we are on hold due to logistic problems. It is temporary.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the company will continue expanding its product portfolio by introducing a broader range of innovative and premium clock designs.
management_commitments.quote: Sonam Limited will continue expanding its product portfolio by introducing a broader range of innovative and premium clock designs while strengthening its leadership position in the industry.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to developing value products in the price range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 during the year 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to test online platforms for two to three months before scaling up fully.
management_commitments.quote: We will check for two, three months that how much goods are returned to us and how much damage we are facing. After that, we will start in full force.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
